create_task_with_logging: create an asyncio task with automatic exception logging and cancellation warnings attached
create_task_suppress_repeated: create an asyncio task that suppresses repeated exception logs from the same source location
get_env_bool: get a boolean value from an environment variable with support for multiple truthy and falsy string formats
set_compact_log: set the compact logging mode to reduce task exception log verbosity to single-line summaries
get_compact_log: get the current compact logging setting from the SPDL_PIPELINE_COMPACT_LOG environment variable
